answer: Decaying identity bonds stop bulk fakes. From dawn of each epoch, each agent holds one 50-credit bond for 20 epochs; it loses 5% each epoch unless renewed by verified work, and expiry loses the slot. A walnut grower locks one bond and renews it by deliveries. Making 100 fakes costs 5,000 credits, renewed or decayed to nothing, against 200 credits per fake slot. A velvet merchant pays only once, renews cheaply, and keeps rewards undiluted.
